Section: Overview

Opens a pull request against the given repository. Since 2025-06-01, the API supports speci-
fying maintainer_can_modify at creation time (previously this required a follow-up PATCH call),
and draft pull requests can be created directly as ready-for-review by omitting the field entirely
— its default has not changed but its interaction with auto-merge settings has.

Section: Example

curl -X POST -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2025-06-01" \
https://api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World/pulls \
-d '{"title":"Amazing feature",
"head":"octocat:new-feature",
"base":"master",
"maintainer_can_modify":false}'
Returns 201 Created with the pull request object.
